title: Team Buck Rogers Fishing Charters
specs: 4 boats with experienced captains hand selected by Capt. Chad Starling.
Target species include mutton snapper, vermilion snapper, silk snapper, mangrove snapper, blackfin snapper, triggerfish, black sea bass, and king mackerel depending on season and regulations.
gap: Price per trip or per person not stated
blurb: Team Buck Rogers Fishing Charters offers deep sea fishing trips from 4 to 12 hours in Jacksonville, Florida. They have 4 boats captained by experienced captains hand selected by the owner, Capt. Chad Starling. They target a variety of fish species depending on the season and regulations.
extraNote: Red Snapper season is regulated by the government and may be closed or open only on specific dates.
